title: 100th Day Worksheets | K–1st Holiday Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 1.NBT.C.4, K.CC.A.1, K.CC.A.2

Give your learners extra practice with 100th Day! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Tens to 100
  • Before and After
  • The 100th Day
  • Make 100
  • Count Up to 100
  • 100 Things
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Tens to 100, Before and After, The 100th Day, Make 100, Count Up to 100, 100 Things), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Holidays, Art & Coding Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
